reuse.why: The check is called once inside the existing linkBankSyncAccount, which every provider already goes through, before findOrCreateBank.

duplication.why: The rule is written once and called once, with nothing copied.

placement.why: The guard lives in accounts/link.ts beside findOrCreateBank and is invoked from the shared link core in app.ts, which matches the tree's layering.

scope.why: The diff only adds the guard, its single call, focused unit tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: The function name says what it does and the parameters are typed. A new provider gets the rule automatically because it is enforced in the common path.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every provider link goes through linkBankSyncAccount, where the guard runs.

one_place.where: link.ts assertBankAccountNotLinkedElsewhere, called once at the top of linkBankSyncAccount (accounts/app.ts), which all five provider link handlers use.
